## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: Energy and Utilities are the only sector-level outperformers while major Tech and Financial names (AAPL, MSFT, JPM) sit BELOW TREND, and there is MAJOR divergence across large caps — keep a neutral stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: VLO (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +18.11%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND. Materials next: DOW (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND, APD (1W: +5.38% | 1M: -0.80%) RECOVERY. Real Estate shows pockets of strength: EQIX (1W: +4.19% | 1M: +3.34%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Industrials weak: GE (1W: -5.57% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND, EMR (1W: -5.69% | 1M: -7.85%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare weak: TMO (1W: -7.75% | 1M: -7.72%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -1.91% | 1M: -4.57%) BELOW TREND. Technology soft: ADBE (1W: -10.83% | 1M: -4.05%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -6.31% | 1M: -5.96%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VLO (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +18.11%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +6.43% | 1M: +11.93%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +16.19%) ABOVE TREND, APD (1W: +5.38% | 1M: -0.80%) RECOVERY, DOW (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND. 5. Worst Performing Stocks?

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: VLO (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +18.11%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +6.43% | 1M: +11.93%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +16.19%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence among large caps (NVDA, AMZN, ADBE) where 1W vs 1M disagree — treat moves as tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed to weak: ADBE (1W: -10.83% | 1M: -4.05%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -6.31% | 1M: -5.96%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: +3.91% | 1M: -5.03%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +0.32% | 1M: -1.98%) RECOVERY. Sector 1W: -1.84% | 1M: +0.64% (24 stocks) — watch for further dispersion and confirmable leadership before re-loading Tech.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft and fragmented: JPM (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -5.45%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.85% | 1M: -4.34%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -1.78% | 1M: -3.59%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -1.89% | 1M: -6.12% (20 stocks) — financials showing weakness, not confirming a rally.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive but slipping: UNH (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.17%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.25% | 1M: -0.03%) RECOVERY, TMO (1W: -7.75% | 1M: -7.72%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -2.35% | 1M: -3.26% (17 stocks) — monitor quality names for stabilization.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and select Materials exposure given concentrated leadership; reduce exposure to lagging Tech names and select Financials showing below-trend action. Style: Cyclical/value-leaning with caution — MAJOR divergence across large caps argues for selectivity and monitoring for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +18.11%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -10.83% | 1M: -4.05%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -6.31% | 1M: -5.96%) BELOW TREND, TMO (1W: -7.75% | 1M: -7.72%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +10.44%) — narrow leadership. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.84% | 1M: +0.64%) and Industrials (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -4.69%) — watch for continued dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +0.32% | 1M: -1.98%) RECOVERY — watch a sustained close above the recent 1W high for trend confirmation. XOM (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND — watch a breakout above prior monthly highs for broad risk confirmation. ADBE (1W: -10.83% | 1M: -4.05%) BELOW TREND — watch for stabilization above near-term support to reduce downside risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
TSLA (+60): TSLA (1W: -0.78% | 1M: -5.16%) BELOW TREND — news on battery deal is positive but price is lagging (divergence). ORCL (+55): ORCL not in the detailed top/bottom list here; monitor for confirmation with price action before rotating exposure. INTU (+65): Intuit shows buyback/news tailwinds — monitor 1W/1M confirmation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ADBE (-50): ADBE (1W: -10.83% | 1M: -4.05%) BELOW TREND — negative CEO news aligns with sharp 1W weakness (sentiment confirms price). QCOM (-50): QCOM (1W: -6.31% | 1M: -5.96%) BELOW TREND — downgrade-driven sell pressure confirmed in price. JPM (-50): JPM (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -5.45%) BELOW TREND — legal/crypto headlines exacerbate below-trend action.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, value/cyclical-leaning given narrow Energy leadership and weak breadth. Energy names XOM (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND and VLO (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +18.11%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength while Tech and Financials remain broadly BELOW TREND. Key risk: MAJOR divergence among large caps (NVDA, AMZN, ADBE) and news-price divergences (TSLA positive news, price below trend) — monitor for confirmation before adding exposure.
